story_info.title: Penny Penguin's Bright Morning
story_info.subtitle: A Saturday Start
story_info.moral: A good morning routine makes you feel happy and ready for the day.

main_character.name: Penny Penguin
main_character.appearance: Penny is a small round penguin with glossy black-and-white feathers, a bright orange beak, and orange webbed feet. She has rosy cheeks and a cheerful, energetic stance.

cover.prompt: Pixar-quality 3D illustration of Penny Penguin, a small round penguin with glossy black-and-white feathers, a bright orange beak, and orange webbed feet, with rosy cheeks and a cheerful, energetic stance. She is sitting up in her cozy bed inside her igloo, stretching her flippers towards the sunny window. A small glass of water is on a tiny table nearby. Soft cinematic lighting, pastel colors, children's book illustration, vertical composition, Instagram friendly.
cover.setting: Penny's cozy igloo on Snowy Shores
cover.visual_action: Penny stretching in her bed as the sun rises

slides.title: A New Day Begins
slides.text: The sun shone brightly on Snowy Shores. Penny Penguin blinked her eyes open. She stretched her little flippers under her warm blanket. "Good morning, world!" she chirped softly. She wiggled her orange webbed feet. Penny was ready for a new Saturday. Healthy habits make every day fun! Her rosy cheeks looked cheerful.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Penny waking up in her favorite place, Snowy Shores, and her cheerful personality.

slides.title: Penguin Stretches
slides.text: Penny hopped out of bed. She stood tall and reached her flippers to the sky. "Stretch, stretch, stretch!" she said. Then she bent down to touch her orange toes. Penny moved her head side to side. Stretching made her body feel awake and ready to play.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Penny doing simple stretches, highlighting the benefit of movement.

slides.title: Fresh Water Sips
slides.text: Penny went to her small kitchen. She poured a big glass of cool water. "Sip, sip, sip!" Penny drank it slowly. Water helps my body wake up. It makes me feel fresh inside. Penny always drank water first. It was a healthy habit.
slides.speaker_notes: Illustrate Penny drinking water, emphasizing its importance for waking up and feeling fresh.

slides.title: Snowy Air Jumps
slides.text: Next, Penny opened her door. She stepped outside her cozy igloo. The air was cool and clean. Penny took three deep breaths. "Woohoo!" she cried. She did five happy little jumps! Fresh air and moving her body made her feel strong.
slides.speaker_notes: Depict Penny enjoying fresh air and a quick physical activity outdoors.

slides.title: Ready to Play
slides.text: Penny felt wonderful. Her black and white feathers felt bouncy. Her bright orange beak had a big smile. Her whole body was awake and happy. "Healthy habits make every day fun!" she sang. Penny was ready for a super Saturday of play and adventure.
slides.speaker_notes: Conclude with Penny feeling great and ready for her day, reinforcing the positive impact of her routine.
